subject: reasoning
question: Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group? (Note: The odd man out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The letter-cluster that DOES NOT belong to the group is QEU.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is.

**For '**QEU**':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8cce70808835ab9bd4e7cef61d2698ed4e780c72ba666b48fa8e0e1968571cd.png] 

**For '**KAQ**':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a15ace2e977449916da8c2019247748d1711d7884608ddd52e2a46f1737fd58f.png] 

**For 'WMC':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93c86dac9a48d5b1c40b124f2e72b0bb538d53fd147ecbb0211294ff44674de1.png] 

**For 'RHX':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0739c963f500b73b2035e17e8a123d4c0cd973325d8e0835dfb7b08523362730.png] 

Thus, the letter-cluster that DOES NOT belong to that group is RHX.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
